user.title: Connect to YNAB
user.description: Create a personal access token in YNAB under Account Settings, Developer Settings. It is stored by Home Assistant only.

plan.title: Choose a plan
plan.description: Pick the YNAB plan (budget) to track.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate YNAB
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {plan_name} no longer works. Enter a new personal access token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach YNAB. Try again shortly.
error.wrong_account: That token cannot access this plan.

abort.already_configured: That plan is already set up.
abort.no_plans: No plans were found for that token.

stages.title: Allocation stages
stages.description: Assign each category group to a waterfall stage. Per-category overrides are set with the set_stage_mapping tool.

low_overrides.title: Low-bucket overrides
low_overrides.description: Override the low threshold for one category. Leave the share empty to clear its override. Current overrides: {current}

abort.not_loaded: Load the integration before changing these options.
